en.t: At long last, Koremitsu no Taifu arrived.

units.source_text: 此人一向朝朝夜夜侍候在侧，偏偏今宵不来，而且找也不易找到，源氏公子觉得可恶。

en.t: He was usually at Genji's side morning and night, yet tonight of all nights he had not come, and he was not easy to find either, which Genji found infuriating.

units.source_text: 然而见了面，又觉得想说的话没有勇气说出，一时默默无言。

en.t: But once they met, Genji found he had no courage to say what he wanted to say, and for a while he remained silent.

units.source_text: 右近看看惟光的模样，察知他是最初的拉拢者，便哭起来。

en.t: Ukon looked at Koremitsu and realized that he was the one who had first arranged the affair, and she began to cry.
Genji could no longer hold back either.

units.source_text: 他本来自命为惟一健全的人，所以抱着右近。

en.t: He had thought of himself as the only one still composed, and so he had been holding Ukon.

units.source_text: 现在一见惟光来到，透了一口气，

en.t: Now, seeing Koremitsu arrive, he breathed a sigh of relief,

units.source_text: 悲痛之情涌上心来，便放声大哭，一时难于自制。

en.t: and grief welled up in his heart, so he burst into loud sobs and for a time could not control himself.

units.source_text: 后来镇静下来，对惟光说：“这里出了怪事！

en.t: Later, after he had calmed down, he said to Koremitsu, "Something strange has happened here!

units.source_text: 恐怖之状不是用惊吓等字眼所能表达的。

en.t: The terror of it cannot be expressed with words like fright or shock.

units.source_text: 听说逢到这种急变时，诵经可以驱除恶魔，

en.t: I have heard that when such a sudden calamity occurs, chanting sutras can drive away evil spirits,

units.source_text: 我想赶快照办，祈求佛佑，让她重生。

en.t: so I want to do it quickly, pray for the Buddha's protection, and bring her back to life.

units.source_text: 我要阿阇梨也一起来，怎么样了？”

en.t: I wanted the ajari to come too. What has happened?"

units.source_text: 惟光回答道：“阿阇梨昨天已经回比叡山去了……

en.t: Koremitsu replied, "The ajari already returned to Mount Hiei yesterday...
This matter is truly strange beyond words.
Has the young lady been ill recently?"

units.source_text: 源氏公子哭道：“一向很好，并没有病。”

en.t: Genji said through his tears, "She had always been well. She was not ill."

units.source_text: 他这哭诉的姿态哀怨动人，惟光看了不胜悲戚，也呜呜地哭了起来。

en.t: The sight of him weeping and pleading was so sorrowful and moving that Koremitsu, overcome with grief as he watched, also began to sob aloud.
